verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; a creative refresh is already in motion.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you generated $7,278.65 in revenue on $1,479 in Meta ad spend — a 4.92 return on ad spend overall. However, the last 7 days tell a harder story: return on ad spend fell 35.24% on nearly identical spend, and the last 3 days (Sep 10–12) produced just 1 purchase versus 8 purchases in the 3 days prior — a confirmed and accelerating decline. The primary driver is creative fatigue on your top campaign, which has absorbed 57% of total budget and is showing the classic signs of a worn-out audience. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to break the fatigue pattern, and we're also investigating a potential checkout friction issue, as site traffic has held steady while purchases have dropped.
